text:
maya: quick sync note  propose a tiny per-tenant fallback flow: local fast-decider + control-plane caps.
eli: agree. keep policy surface tiny.
tony: signals: 30s p95, queue-length, kv-hit-rate, small-eval quality flag.
raven: fallback order: same-family lower-precision -> co-located sibling -> cached-last-good. avoid cross-family unless opt-in.
maya: anti-oscillation: stability window (3s) + cooldown (30s) + leaky-bucket cap.
eli: session affinity: prefer fallback nodes that preserve KV locality; otherwise return cached-last-good with warning header.
tony: telemetry: reason codes: capacity, latency_spike, quality_regression, operator_override, probe_timeout. include tenant_id, route, variant, token_delta_est.
maya: rollout: observability-only -> internal opt-in 48h -> small external cohort. ops thresholds and pager rules in RFC.
raven: I'll draft the RFC and sim harness.
deploy-bot: job queued: safepath-canary-v1 -> canary 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z :rocket:
